messages:
Jamie: Heads-up — BigBank POC kickoff next Tue. Need an integration playbook for SEs, short answers pack for their security questionnaire, and a pricing sketch for streaming vs Dedicated commit. Can someone take point?

Ravi: I can own the integration playbook. Quick q: will they be using our SDK streaming path or a simple REST loop? That changes the sample code we should give.

Jamie: They want streaming for live docs editing + function/tool calls to pull internal KVPs. Also ask for structured JSON output for downstream ingestion.

Ravi: Got it. I'll prepare a minimal streaming + function-calling example and a small harness.

Morgan: For the POC infra: we should provide a dockerized local harness that mirrors streaming behavior and a small dataset + eval prompts. Canary plan: start with hosted API, then show Dedicated path for committed throughput. Recommend these steps: 1) local proof-of-concept with SDK 2) hosted POC for latency demo 3) Dedicated sizing proposal if they need sustained throughput.

Priya: I can handle the security questionnaire items. Need answers for: data residency, retention period, KMS/HSM integration, SOC2 scope, subprocessor list, and egress controls. Also confirm whether logs include PII and how it's redacted. Please add specific questions they flagged in the doc.

Jamie: I'll paste their top-5 security asks here in a minute. Also they want rough cost per 1M streaming tokens + delta for Dedicated 1G commit.

Ravi: For the SDK snippet we should show streaming with function calling + structured output schema. Example (JS):

```js
// streaming + function call (simplified)
const stream = await redwood.stream({
  model: 'redwood-1-stream',
  stream: true,
  function_call: 'auto',
  functions: [
    {
      name: 'lookup_customer',
      parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { id: { type: 'string' } } }
    }
  ],
  onToken: token => process.stdout.write(token)
})

// handle function call results on the server side and emit structured JSON
```

Ravi: For structured output, recommend using a validation schema and post-validate on each message. Example schema (pseudo):

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"action":{"type":"string"},"payload":{"type":"object"}},"required":["action"]}
```

Morgan: For the demo, include a fallback policy note: if function_call fails, show graceful degradation to text answer + a link to manual lookup. Also include token-budget examples for typical flows (edit session, 50k tokens; lookup-heavy session, 200k tokens).

Priya: On compliance: we can offer VPC/private deployment for sensitive data. KMS integration supported via customer-managed keys. We need legal to sign the DPA + (if required) an addendum for specific regulatory controls. I'll draft canned answers for the questionnaire.

deploy-bot: POC environment created: id=poc-bigbank-1779007788, url=https://console.redwood.example/poc/poc-bigbank-1779007788 :white_check_mark:

Jamie: Perfect. Two asks before EOD: (1) Ravi, drop the SDK + REST snippets into a one-pager (2) Morgan, sketch the canary/migration steps and a sample SLA comparison table (hosted vs Dedicated).

Ravi: On pricing: rough ballpark for discussion — hosted streaming: $X per 1M input+output tokens (I'll put exact numbers in the one-pager). Dedicated: show monthly committed GPU pricing tiers and equivalent tokens/sec throughput. I'll include delta calculations for 3-month and 12-month commits.

Morgan: Also add a quick troubleshooting checklist: common streaming issues (incomplete stream due to short timeout, partial function JSON, connection keepalive), and a small local test harness command:

```bash
# run local harness
docker run --rm -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=... redwood/poc-harness:latest --scenario=streaming-lookup
```

Priya: FYI — they asked about audit logs retention 13 months and searchability. We support configurable retention up to 36 months; searchable logs via console export. I'll confirm export formats (CSV/NDJSON).

Jamie: Awesome. I'm going to start a short answers doc for the security questionnaire and paste into the SFDC deal notes. Please flag anything that needs legal or pricing signoff.

Ravi: Will do. I'll attach the one-pager and a tiny repo with examples. Link-to-repo will be in the playbook.

Morgan: I'll prepare the demo script and include a small checklist for the customer-side infra pre-reqs (network egress, SSO, service account).

Priya: Looping in legal with the questionnaire after I finish the draft.

Jamie: Thanks team :thumbsup: — let's review tomorrow at 9am PT.
